1945. Bank Account Management Using Constructors

50

Medium

Problem Statement

Write a program to create a bank account using a constructor and display account details along with bonus calculations.

Description

Create a class named BankAccount containing:

Account Number
Account Holder Name
Balance

Use a parameterized constructor to initialize these values.

Perform the following operations:

Display Account Number.
Display Account Holder Name.
Display Current Balance.
Add a bonus amount of ₹1000 to the balance.
Display the updated balance.

Account Holder: Ravi
